Package bakerydms

The Bakery Order Management System: a Swing program that manages custom cake orders for a small bakery and stores them in a MySQL database.

The program has three layers. Each layer only talks to the one below it:

Layers and their classes
LayerClassesJob
Presentation BakeryApp, BakeryOrderWindow, OrderTableModel, Theme, CakeLogo Starts the program, shows the window and reads what the user types
Business logic OrderManager, OrderValidator, Order, DailyReport Checks every value, runs add / update / delete, and builds the Daily Production Report
Data OrderRepository, MySqlOrderRepository, DatabaseConnector, DataAccessException Connects to MySQL with the details the user enters and runs the SQL

How an action flows: the user clicks Add Order, then BakeryOrderWindow reads the form, then OrderManager validates it with OrderValidator, then MySqlOrderRepository runs INSERT INTO orders, and the window refreshes the table and shows the result in the status bar.

Setup: run the bakery_dms.sql script to create the bakery_dms database with 25 sample orders. Then start BakeryApp and enter the MySQL server, port, database, username and password in the window.

Version:
4.0 (Phase 4, Module 11)

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    OrderRepository
    Describes what the program needs from its data storage: find, add, change and delete orders.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    BakeryApp
    Starts the Bakery Order Management System.
    BakeryOrderWindow
    The main window of the program and the only screen the user works with (the presentation layer).
    CakeLogo
    Draws the bakery's logo, a two-tier cake with a candle, using Java 2D.
    DailyReport
    The result of the custom action, the Daily Production Report.
    DatabaseConnector
    Connects the program to the user's MySQL database.
    MySqlOrderRepository
    Stores orders in the orders table of a MySQL database (the data layer).
    Order
    One custom cake order, the object the whole system manages.
    OrderFileLoader
    Loads Order objects from a delimited text file.
    OrderManager
    Carries out every action on orders (the business logic layer).
    OrderTableModel
    Supplies order data to the JTable in BakeryOrderWindow.
    OrderValidator
    Keeps every data rule in one place and cleans up what the user types.
    Theme
    The look of the program: colors, fonts and ready-styled Swing components.
  • Exception Summary 
    Exception Description
    DataAccessException
    Signals a database problem, with a message written for the user.
    InputCancelledException
    Thrown when the user types "cancel" at a prompt.
    InputEndedException
    Thrown when there is no more keyboard input to read.
